text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from buying equipment
for
Tokai Teio...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
We've been walking foreveeer. I'm
tiiiired. Hey,
can we take a break for a
second?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yay! Then, let's go to a cafe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she wishes, we drop by a nearby
cafe...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey, it's Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heyo, Mayano! Are you taking a break
here too?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ Why, yes I am!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'm here to drink some black coffee!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And with this sip of maturity, I'll take
flight into
the skies of adulthood one
step ahead of you! ☆

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey! I can drink black coffee too, you
know!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just watch me! Trainer, Mayano, let's get
in there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
True to their word, both Teio and
Mayano order
black coffee.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several minutes later, their drinks arrive.

However...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: S-so bitter!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Um, I mean! The bitterness adds such a
mature
taste, doesn't it? ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Y-yep! But don't you think it's a bit too mature for you?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: M-me? You're the one who looks like you've eaten some sour plums!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems neither is enjoying the black
coffee's
bitterness.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
N-no way! I wanna settle this here and
now!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Same! An adult never gives up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After I point that out, their eagerness to
prove
themselves fades and the pair falls
into a sudden
silence.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Th-that does make some sense.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Adults have discerning palates, don't
they?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They both look at each other, nod, then
begin to
add copious amounts of milk,
sugar, and syrup to
their cups.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! This still makes me feel pretty
mature.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah! But not as mature as me!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Don't be such a sore loser!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're one to talk! My victory was
inevitable right
from the beginning!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey, you think so too right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What?! Then I'm gonna try a whole
bunch of
drinks and show you how
mature I really am!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, they order an array of sweet
drinks
and enjoy refining their "adult"
tastes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Teio learned something from
her drinking
contest with her friend.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The moment I say it, I feel their gaze on
me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
O-oh, you do, huh? Now that I think
about it, I'm
pretty hungry too.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Me too! Something like pancakes with a
bunch of
whipped cream sounds nice.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you're gonna order, then we
might as well
order something too.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Good idea!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They both order some dessert to wash
away the
bitterness of the black coffee.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Mmm, that was delicious!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to their sweet desserts, they
were both
able to finish their black
coffees.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
My pancakes were so good! I'm gonna
order 'em
again the next time I come!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the fruit parfait was great too!
And the ice
cream was so creamy! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I feel so mature already!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We look totally different now,
don't we?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Come on! You're supposed to say "Yes!"
and
praise us!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Teio looks disappointed, but after I
apologize for
my rash remarks and praise
her, her mood
instantly brightens.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems she learned something from
spending
some "grown-up time" with
Mayano.
